_comment: Paymentos (BankLink) endpoints mapping for KrakenD - UAT/SQA/SIT

endpoints._comment: === JDPI SPI (Pix Agendado - Sistema de Pagamentos Instantaneos) ===
DICT - List PIX keys (specific route must come before parameterized {chave})
PIX via chave (CPF, CNPJ, email, telefone, random)
PIX Cobranca com Vencimento (payment request with due date)
PIX via QR Code Dinamico (dynamic QR code)
PIX via QR Code Estatico (static QR code)
Download de RCO (Relacao de Contas Operacionais) - arquivo mensal
Teste de conectividade com o SPI/JDPI
